title: NLE-Predictor: Automated Non-Linear Effect Predictors and Thermodynamic Intelligence for Asymmetric Catalysis
description:
NLE-Predictor is an open-source, reproducible computational instrument and kinetic modeling engine designed to model, predict, and analyze Non-Linear Effects (NLE) in asymmetric synthesis and catalytic reaction design.

Features include:

  • Automated conformer sampling (CREST/xTB) and DFT Gibbs free energy evaluation (ORCA/Gaussian)
  • Exact analytical Jacobian mass-balance solvers for quadratic convergence in stiff regimes (K ≥ 107)
  • Kagan ML2 Reservoir and Active Dimer kinetic models
  • Noyori DAIB aggregation model reproducing asymmetric amplification in dialkylzinc additions
  • Non-linear least-squares regression for experimental enantiopurity data pairs with 95% confidence intervals
  • Self-contained interactive desktop HTML dashboard and standalone Windows executable
